newsitem.title: POLAND: BPH mulls selling stake in RMF FM radio.
newsitem.headline: BPH mulls selling stake in RMF FM radio.

text.p: Poland's Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA said on Tuesday it is considering selling its 40 percent stake in radio station RMF FM.

"BPH is concerned over the third consecutive annual loss by RMF in 1996...It is realistic that, if there is an investor willing to buy the (BPH) stake, and if this proves acceptable to the bank, the transaction may take place," BPH president Henryka Pieronkiewicz told reporters.
She said RMF FM had a 4.1-million-zloty loss last year, but gave no further details.
